caption: The drawing depicts three main objects: a long, wide brown leather strap with a metal buckle and some tied strings, a powder horn that is attached to the strap and has a curved, tapering shape with a combination of brown, beige, and gray hues, and a rectangular bag or pouch with a quilted and stitched texture, predominantly dark brown with hints of lighter brown and black. The horn and bag appear to be connected by the leather strap, which loops and bends in a loose, organic way. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white color with a faint border, creating a neutral setting for the items.
title: Bullet Pouch and Powder Horn
